sys_hub_flow.description:
Generates a chat completion response from the model given an input chat conversation.

Inputs:

  • Model - The name of your model deployment.
  • Transaction ID - The transaction ID.
  • Messages - An array of message objects with the following fields:
    • Role - The role of the message's author. One of user, assistant.
    • Content - An array of content objects with the following fields. Only one of the following members can be specified when used.
      • Text - Text to include in the message.
      • Document - A document to include in the message.
        • Name - A name for the document.
        • Format - The format of a document, or its extension.
        • Source - The source object with the following fields.
          • Bytes - Base64-encoded binary data of the document.
      • Image - Image to include in the message.
        • Format - The format of the image.
        • Source - The source object with the following fields.
          • Bytes - Base64-encoded binary data of the image.
      • Guard Content - Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
        • Text - The guardrail text object with the following fields.
          • Text - The text that you want to guard.
          • Qualifiers - The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.
  • Inference Config - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    • Max Tokens - The maximum number of tokens to allow in the generated response.
    • Temperature - The likelihood of the model selecting higher-probability options while generating a response. A lower value makes the model more likely to choose higher-probability options, while a higher value makes the model more likely to choose lower-probability options.
    • Top P - The percentage of most-likely candidates that the model considers for the next token. For example, if you choose a value of 0.8 for topP, the model selects from the top 80% of the probability distribution of tokens that could be next in the sequence.
    • Stop Sequences - A list of stop sequences. A stop sequence is a sequence of characters that causes the model to stop generating the response.
  • Guardrail Config - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    • Guardrail Identifier - The identifier for the guardrail.
    • Guardrail Version - The version of the guardrail.
    • Trace - The trace behavior for the guardrail.
  • Additional Model Request Fields - Additional inference parameters that the model supports, beyond the base set of inference parameters that action supports in the Inference Config field.
  • Additional Model Response Field Paths - Additional model parameters field paths to return in the response.
  • System - An array of system objects with the following fields.
    • Text - System prompt for the model.
    • Guard Content - Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
      • Text - The guardrail text object with the following fields.
        • Text - The text that you want to guard.
        • Qualifiers - The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.

Outputs:

  • Output - Output object with the following fields:
    • Message - The message that model generates.
      • Role - The role of the message's author.
      • Content - An array of content objects with the following fields.
        • Text - Text which is included in the message.
  • Metrics - Metrics object with the following fields:
    • LatencyMs - The latency of the call to Converse, in milliseconds.
  • Stop Reason - The reason why the model stopped generating output.
  • Usage - An object with the following fields:
    • Input Tokens - Number of tokens in the prompt.
    • Output Tokens - Number of tokens generated in the completion
    • Total Tokens- The total number of tokens.
  • Action Status - An object with the following fields:
    • Code - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
    • Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.

sys_hub_flow_snapshot.description:
Generates a chat completion response from the model given an input chat conversation.

Inputs:

  • Model - The name of your model deployment.
  • Transaction ID - The transaction ID.
  • Messages - An array of message objects with the following fields:
    • Role - The role of the message's author. One of user, assistant.
    • Content - An array of content objects with the following fields. Only one of the following members can be specified when used.
      • Text - Text to include in the message.
      • Document - A document to include in the message.
        • Name - A name for the document.
        • Format - The format of a document, or its extension.
        • Source - The source object with the following fields.
          • Bytes - Base64-encoded binary data of the document.
      • Image - Image to include in the message.
        • Format - The format of the image.
        • Source - The source object with the following fields.
          • Bytes - Base64-encoded binary data of the image.
      • Guard Content - Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
        • Text - The guardrail text object with the following fields.
          • Text - The text that you want to guard.
          • Qualifiers - The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.
  • Inference Config - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    • Max Tokens - The maximum number of tokens to allow in the generated response.
    • Temperature - The likelihood of the model selecting higher-probability options while generating a response. A lower value makes the model more likely to choose higher-probability options, while a higher value makes the model more likely to choose lower-probability options.
    • Top P - The percentage of most-likely candidates that the model considers for the next token. For example, if you choose a value of 0.8 for topP, the model selects from the top 80% of the probability distribution of tokens that could be next in the sequence.
    • Stop Sequences - A list of stop sequences. A stop sequence is a sequence of characters that causes the model to stop generating the response.
  • Guardrail Config - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    • Guardrail Identifier - The identifier for the guardrail.
    • Guardrail Version - The version of the guardrail.
    • Trace - The trace behavior for the guardrail.
  • Additional Model Request Fields - Additional inference parameters that the model supports, beyond the base set of inference parameters that action supports in the Inference Config field.
  • Additional Model Response Field Paths - Additional model parameters field paths to return in the response.
  • System - An array of system objects with the following fields.
    • Text - System prompt for the model.
    • Guard Content - Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
      • Text - The guardrail text object with the following fields.
        • Text - The text that you want to guard.
        • Qualifiers - The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.

Outputs:

  • Output - Output object with the following fields:
    • Message - The message that model generates.
      • Role - The role of the message's author.
      • Content - An array of content objects with the following fields.
        • Text - Text which is included in the message.
  • Metrics - Metrics object with the following fields:
    • LatencyMs - The latency of the call to Converse, in milliseconds.
  • Stop Reason - The reason why the model stopped generating output.
  • Usage - An object with the following fields:
    • Input Tokens - Number of tokens in the prompt.
    • Output Tokens - Number of tokens generated in the completion
    • Total Tokens- The total number of tokens.
  • Action Status - An object with the following fields:
    • Code - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
    • Message - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_hub_flow"><sys_hub_flow action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><acls/><active>false</active><allow_high_security_roles>false</allow_high_security_roles><annotation/><attributes>browserActivatedIn=firefox,integrationActivatedIn=standalone,labelCacheCleanUpExecuted=true,timeFromCreateToActivate=17616248000,viewActivatedIn=naturalLanguage</attributes><authored_on_release_version>26000</authored_on_release_version><callable_by_client_api>false</callable_by_client_api><category display_value="Chat Completions Management">66fa7e0743334210b4cc43852db8f2f5</category><copied_from>033585c6374822103f0265f734924b7b</copied_from><copied_from_name>Chat Completions Wrapper</copied_from_name><description><style>
    .mandatory::after {
        content: "* ";
        color: red;
    }
</style>
<p>Generates a chat completion response from the model given an input chat conversation. </p>
<p>
    <strong>Inputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Model</strong> - The name of your model deployment.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Transaction ID</strong> - The transaction ID.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Messages</strong> - An array of message objects with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>Role </strong>- The role of the message's author. One of user, assistant.</li>
            <li> <strong>Content </strong>- An array of content objects with the following fields. Only one of the following members can be specified when used.
                <ul>
                    <li> <strong>Text </strong>- Text to include in the message.</li>
                    <li> <strong>Document </strong>- A document to include in the message.
                        <ul>
                            <li> <strong>Name </strong>- A name for the document.</li>
                            <li> <strong>Format </strong>- The format of a document, or its extension.
                            </li>
                            <li> <strong>Source </strong>- The source object with the following fields.
                                <ul>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Bytes </strong>- Base64-encoded binary data of the document.
                                    </li>
                                </ul>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    <li> <strong>Image </strong>- Image to include in the message.
                        <ul>

                            <li> <strong>Format </strong>- The format of the image.
                            </li>
                            <li> <strong>Source </strong>- The source object with the following fields.
                                <ul>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Bytes </strong>- Base64-encoded binary data of the image.
                                    </li>
                                </ul>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    </li>
                    <li> <strong>Guard Content </strong>- Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
                        <ul>


                            <li> <strong>Text </strong>- The guardrail text object with the following fields.
                                <ul>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Text </strong>- The text that you want to guard.
                                    </li>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Qualifiers </strong>- The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.
                                    </li>
                                </ul>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    </li>
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Inference Config</strong> - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Max Tokens</strong> - The maximum number of tokens to allow in the generated response.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Temperature</strong> - The likelihood of the model selecting higher-probability options while generating a response. A lower value makes the model more likely to choose higher-probability options, while a higher value makes the model more likely to choose lower-probability options.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top P</strong> - The percentage of most-likely candidates that the model considers for the next token. For example, if you choose a value of 0.8 for topP, the model selects from the top 80% of the probability distribution of tokens that could be next in the sequence.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Stop Sequences</strong> - A list of stop sequences. A stop sequence is a sequence of characters that causes the model to stop generating the response.
        </li>
    </ul>
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Guardrail Config</strong> - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Guardrail Identifier</strong> - The identifier for the guardrail.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Guardrail Version</strong> - The version of the guardrail.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Trace</strong> - The trace behavior for the guardrail.
        </li>

    </ul>
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Additional Model Request Fields</strong> - Additional inference parameters that the model supports, beyond the base set of inference parameters that action supports in the Inference Config field.
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Additional Model Response Field Paths</strong> - Additional model parameters field paths to return in the response.
</li>
<li> <strong>System </strong>- An array of system objects with the following fields.
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Text </strong>- System prompt for the model.
        </li>
        <li> <strong>Guard Content </strong>- Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
            <ul>


                <li> <strong>Text </strong>- The guardrail text object with the following fields.
                    <ul>
                        <li>
                            <strong>Text </strong>- The text that you want to guard.
                        </li>
                        <li>
                            <strong>Qualifiers </strong>- The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>

</li>
</ul>

<p>
    <strong>Outputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Output</strong> - Output object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>Message </strong>- The message that model generates.
                <ul>
                    <li> <strong>Role </strong>- The role of the message's author. </li>
                    <li> <strong>Content </strong>- An array of content objects with the following fields.
                        <ul>
                            <li> <strong>Text </strong>- Text which is included in the message.</li>
                        </ul>
                    </li>

                </ul>
            </li>


        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Metrics</strong> - Metrics object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>LatencyMs </strong>- The latency of the call to Converse, in milliseconds.</li>

        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Stop Reason</strong> - The reason why the model stopped generating output.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Usage</strong> - An object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>Input Tokens </strong>- Number of tokens in the prompt.</li>
            <li> <strong>Output Tokens </strong>- Number of tokens generated in the completion</li>
            <li> <strong>Total Tokens</strong>- The total number of tokens.</li>
        </ul>
    </li>

    <li>
        <strong>Action Status</strong> - An object with the following fields: <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Code</strong> - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Message</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul></description><display_name_after_preview/><flow_priority>MEDIUM</flow_priority><generation_source/><internal_name>chat_completions_sse_wrapper</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.request_metadata","label":"Input➛Request </style>
<p>Generates a chat completion response from the model given an input chat conversation. </p>
<p>
    <strong>Inputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Model</strong> - The name of your model deployment.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong class="mandatory">Transaction ID</strong> - The transaction ID.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Messages</strong> - An array of message objects with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>Role </strong>- The role of the message's author. One of user, assistant.</li>
            <li> <strong>Content </strong>- An array of content objects with the following fields. Only one of the following members can be specified when used.
                <ul>
                    <li> <strong>Text </strong>- Text to include in the message.</li>
                    <li> <strong>Document </strong>- A document to include in the message.
                        <ul>
                            <li> <strong>Name </strong>- A name for the document.</li>
                            <li> <strong>Format </strong>- The format of a document, or its extension.
                            </li>
                            <li> <strong>Source </strong>- The source object with the following fields.
                                <ul>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Bytes </strong>- Base64-encoded binary data of the document.
                                    </li>
                                </ul>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    <li> <strong>Image </strong>- Image to include in the message.
                        <ul>

                            <li> <strong>Format </strong>- The format of the image.
                            </li>
                            <li> <strong>Source </strong>- The source object with the following fields.
                                <ul>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Bytes </strong>- Base64-encoded binary data of the image.
                                    </li>
                                </ul>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    </li>
                    <li> <strong>Guard Content </strong>- Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
                        <ul>


                            <li> <strong>Text </strong>- The guardrail text object with the following fields.
                                <ul>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Text </strong>- The text that you want to guard.
                                    </li>
                                    <li>
                                        <strong>Qualifiers </strong>- The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.
                                    </li>
                                </ul>
                            </li>
                        </ul>
                    </li>
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Inference Config</strong> - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Max Tokens</strong> - The maximum number of tokens to allow in the generated response.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Temperature</strong> - The likelihood of the model selecting higher-probability options while generating a response. A lower value makes the model more likely to choose higher-probability options, while a higher value makes the model more likely to choose lower-probability options.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Top P</strong> - The percentage of most-likely candidates that the model considers for the next token. For example, if you choose a value of 0.8 for topP, the model selects from the top 80% of the probability distribution of tokens that could be next in the sequence.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Stop Sequences</strong> - A list of stop sequences. A stop sequence is a sequence of characters that causes the model to stop generating the response.
        </li>
    </ul>
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Guardrail Config</strong> - Inference parameters to pass to the model.
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Guardrail Identifier</strong> - The identifier for the guardrail.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Guardrail Version</strong> - The version of the guardrail.
        </li>
        <li>
            <strong>Trace</strong> - The trace behavior for the guardrail.
        </li>

    </ul>
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Additional Model Request Fields</strong> - Additional inference parameters that the model supports, beyond the base set of inference parameters that action supports in the Inference Config field.
</li>
<li>
    <strong>Additional Model Response Field Paths</strong> - Additional model parameters field paths to return in the response.
</li>
<li> <strong>System </strong>- An array of system objects with the following fields.
    <ul>
        <li>
            <strong>Text </strong>- System prompt for the model.
        </li>
        <li> <strong>Guard Content </strong>- Contains the content to assess with the guardrail.
            <ul>


                <li> <strong>Text </strong>- The guardrail text object with the following fields.
                    <ul>
                        <li>
                            <strong>Text </strong>- The text that you want to guard.
                        </li>
                        <li>
                            <strong>Qualifiers </strong>- The qualifier details for the guardrails contextual grounding filter.
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </li>
            </ul>
        </li>
    </ul>

</li>
</ul>

<p>
    <strong>Outputs:</strong>
</p>
<ul>
    <li>
        <strong>Output</strong> - Output object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>Message </strong>- The message that model generates.
                <ul>
                    <li> <strong>Role </strong>- The role of the message's author. </li>
                    <li> <strong>Content </strong>- An array of content objects with the following fields.
                        <ul>
                            <li> <strong>Text </strong>- Text which is included in the message.</li>
                        </ul>
                    </li>

                </ul>
            </li>


        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Metrics</strong> - Metrics object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>LatencyMs </strong>- The latency of the call to Converse, in milliseconds.</li>

        </ul>
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Stop Reason</strong> - The reason why the model stopped generating output.
    </li>
    <li>
        <strong>Usage</strong> - An object with the following fields:
        <ul>
            <li> <strong>Input Tokens </strong>- Number of tokens in the prompt.</li>
            <li> <strong>Output Tokens </strong>- Number of tokens generated in the completion</li>
            <li> <strong>Total Tokens</strong>- The total number of tokens.</li>
        </ul>
    </li>

    <li>
        <strong>Action Status</strong> - An object with the following fields: <ul>
            <li>
                <strong>Code</strong> - If the request is executed successfully, code will be set to 0 but if the request failed, code will be set to 1.
            </li>
            <li>
                <strong>Message</strong> - Reason for error. Populated only when an error occurs.
            </li>
        </ul>
    </li>
</ul></description><flow_priority>MEDIUM</flow_priority><internal_name>chat_completions_sse_wrapper</internal_name><label_cache>[{"name":"subflow.request_metadata","label":"Input➛Request
